verdict.rationale: Open Finance is a REST API platform with token-based auth (PartnerID/secret/appKey), a non-interactive Sandbox/Test Drive plan, and a GitHub project that generates an API client library for automated testing — all of which support headless, scriptable use in CI-like environments. However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline example, SDK for automation frameworks, or documentation calling out CI-specific usage. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration guide, official SDKs/automation examples, and evidence of non-interactive end-to-end runs beyond sandbox testing.
